The more planning and thought that goes into guideline development at the beginning, the more efficient the entire process will be and the better the end product. The principles of good project management and high-quality research apply to guideline development. Careful consideration of the issues raised in this chapter and efforts put into developing a thorough and reasoned planning proposal (see Chapter 4) will reduce the time and resources expended on the guideline and result in a superior, more useful final product.
